2 · Early-fail staircase (proposed)

A PR climbs only as high as its change class needs. Height = relative cost. required today jobs are named in the tooltip.

CPU only (every code PR) GPU: L1 unit pod required today; others only on path match Full: label or nightly

Target: L0 → CPU E2E finishes in ≤ 15 min. Times from P1 (p50 wall) and P4 (server bench ~20–25 s per run on WSL CPU). Layout-smoke cost is an estimate (P6).

Lower = cheaper and earlier. A failing step stops the climb.

StepIn plain wordsRuns on / timeWhat it catchesExampleExists today?

Rule: a test lives in the lowest step that can still catch its bug.

1 · The 8 layers a PR crosses

Left to right. Bottom line = main finding.

LAYER 1
PR event
What changed? Which labels?
full label is auto-added to 95 of 100 PRs, so it says nothing about the change
LAYER 2
Trigger
GHA always on code; Buildkite MP on mp/full/force-ci
Override should be force-ci or a new mp-full
LAYER 3
Classify by path
Today: all or nothing (path-filter.sh)
Proposed: 8 change classes → required tiers (P8)
LAYER 4
Test tier
Which layers must run?
Cheap, fast gates first; heavy GPU only when the path needs it
LAYER 5
Workload / job
~35 MP jobs, 0–4 GPUs each
2,099 no-op SGLang jobs wait ~20 min, then exit in 5 s
LAYER 6
Acceptance
What does PASS mean?
~30 thresholds in 15+ files; TTFT check never runs (C9)
LAYER 7
Verdict + retry
Bug, flake or infra?
1 real code catch in 30 days; failures cluster on node 248
LAYER 8
Mergeable
Time-to-green, GPU per PR
Core-only PR: 518 → ~3 GPU-min per build (P8)

4 · CPU E2E: one script, two runners

.github/scripts/run-cpu-e2e-validation.sh — real vLLM-CPU + LMCache server.

requiredBuildkite cpu_e2e_validationin k3-multiprocess-test · 3 transfer modes · 3.6 min p50 · 1,034 runs / 30 d
advisoryGHA cpu_device.yml7 legs · Ubuntu + macOS · opt-125m + DeepSeek-V2-Lite (MLA, dummy) · zmq / grpc / aio / native
  1. Startserver + vLLM serve
  2. Transportlog shows expected mode
  3. Store1st request writes chunks
  4. Hit2nd request reads chunks
  5. Resetmiss, then re-store
  6. RestartvLLM restarts, still hit
  7. Same output5 runs identical
  8. No false hitother prompt misses

GHA legs also run lmcache bench server (2 modes) first. Newest 200 cpu_device runs (2026-11-06 → 11-08, gh run list on 2026-11-09): 124 skipped by the path filter; of the 76 that ran, 39 ok · 9 fail · 12 cancelled · 16 waiting for approval.

6 · PR GPU-min in 30 days

Today vs the proposed rule (shadow run on 223 PRs).

Worst case: new tiers cost 2× the estimate and a perf canary runs on every code PR. Source: P8 §5.3.

Removing the baseline engine

Four workloads start a 2nd engine on a 2nd GPU just to compare (P5).

Baseline CV is 2–7%, so a stored baseline is viable. Total ≈ 43,200 GPU-min (≈ 23%). Overlaps with the rule saving.
